title: Independent Held-Out Qualification of the Bounded Stiffness-Aware Richards Temporal Indicator

held_out_matrix.fixture: same source-locked homogeneous four-node B1.10 hydraulic fixture
held_out_matrix.hydraulic_material: same admitted B1.10 default MVG material as F-SI24 owner characterization
held_out_matrix.top_flux_rule: minus initial hydraulic conductivity so the pre-jump uniform profile is stationary

finite_comparator_semantics.E1_512: max_i abs(h_N1-h_N512) at the same endpoint and frozen case
finite_comparator_semantics.reference_failure_rule: Any required frozen qualification trajectory that fails to produce a finite endpoint under frozen controls is persisted as held-out domain failure and the qualification does not pass.

gates.VQ30_G01_SOURCE_LOCK: Exact F-SI24 candidate semantics and source-locked owner evidence remain unchanged.
gates.VQ30_G02_EXACT_LINEAR_REGRESSION: Independently reproduce the exact constant-linear manufactured bound behavior with factor 2, combined min route and head-infinity M conversion; no formula drift.
gates.VQ30_G03_HELD_OUT_NONLINEAR_TRANSFER: Every frozen held-out case must produce finite candidate metrics and finite qualification comparator, pass domain checks, and have no negative B_inf transfer relative to E1_512. Report state/horizon dependence and conservatism without calling N512 exact truth.
gates.VQ30_G04_BOUNDED_COST: Candidate normal path is exactly one unchanged principal nonlinear Richards solve plus at most one additional tridiagonal defect solve and O(N) accepted-state operator evaluation. N128/N256/N512 trajectories exist only in this independent qualification harness and are forbidden from the production candidate path.
gates.VQ30_G05_HARD_MASS: Indicator is observer-only and may not alter candidate state, accepted fluxes or mass accounting. Every principal and qualification-reference trajectory retains the unchanged 1e-12 hard mass gate.
gates.VQ30_G06_O0_O2: Machine-readable O0 and O2 outputs must be bitwise identical under the current qualification convention.
gates.VQ30_G07_OPERATOR_OWNERSHIP: Any future production accepted-state operator evaluation must be solver-owned through the soil-water solver interface. No external module may read, retain or reimplement HeadCalc Jacobian/internal arrays.
gates.VQ30_G08_NO_EMPIRICAL_RESCUE: No multiplier, safety factor, tolerance, material coefficient, floor inflation or state normalization may be fitted after held-out execution.
gates.VQ30_G09_FVQ28_RECONCILIATION: This candidate is not raw step-doubling or retry translation. The normal candidate path contains no deep refinement trajectory and no second nonlinear companion solve; it uses accepted-state local information plus one bounded-cost tridiagonal defect solve. F-VQ28 therefore remains a negative result for the old retry translation and is not overwritten.

pass_rules: All G01-G09 checks pass exactly as frozen.
All 16 held-out principal N1 attempts converge and pass hard mass under frozen controls.
All 16 frozen N512 qualification comparators are finite and available under frozen controls.
All 16 candidate B_inf values are finite and nonnegative.
Negative held-out transfer cases equal zero.
Exact-linear independent regression passes without formula changes.
Production Richards/runtime/adapter source remains unchanged from base_commit.
fail_closed_rules: Any B_inf<E1_512 case rejects held-out transfer of the current candidate.
Any required comparator/domain failure prevents PASS without changing the frozen matrix or controls.
No failed case may be removed after execution.
No empirical scale or tolerance may repair a negative result.
On failure return to numerical-method design, preserving exact-linear evidence separately.
next_action: After this plan is committed, implement a VQ-owned exact-linear regression and held-out B1.10 qualification harness without changing production source, then execute exactly the frozen matrix.
